_doc: Opt-in changes a release brings to existing homelab repos: things init_repo.py --sync-managed must NOT do
by itself (user-owned files, config choices, snapshots to regenerate, steps on external systems).
init_repo.py --sync-managed [--dry-run] lists the ones that apply to the repo and are newer than its
upgrades.reviewed version (homelab.yaml), as 'suggested, needs your yes'. Maintainers: add a note for
every release that adds something an existing repo has to adopt by hand.
Fields: version, id, kind (config | template | regenerate | manual), text, edited, action, when, after_replace.
text says what the release changed; edited (optional) says why the repo's copy was not replaced: it is shown
only while the note is a suggestion, not when --sync-managed replacing the file settles it (GitHub #76).
A template note whose file (file_lacks/file_has) has no local edits is settled by --sync-managed replacing the
file with the template (template-history.json); after_replace is what is left to do then (optional).
when (all must hold): component (enabled), config_empty (dotted key unset/empty), config_set (dotted key set),
file_lacks [path, text] or a list of them (any of the files exists and lacks its text),
file_has [path, text] or a list of them (each file exists and has its text),
file_missing path (a file a release added is not in the repo; {template} is its template),
vmids_outside_ranges (snapshot VMIDs don't fit), agent_ips_unread (discovery/proxmox.json says the guest
agent IPs were not read: guest_ip_sources.agent present and not ok), default_site_implicit (two or more sites
and the default one has no ranges, VLANs without a site or no site_<default> group), multi_site (two or more
sites).
Placeholders in text, edited, action and after_replace: {HM} skill dir, {template} template file of the first
file_lacks file still lacking its text, {files} all those files, {detail} computed hint,
{site} the default site's name (default_site_implicit).

notes.text: cloud-image-base refuses a base image without a checksum (a tampered or truncated download would go unnoticed); allow_unverified_image = true waives it for one base.
notes.edited: tofu/modules/cloud-image-base/main.tf has local edits, so it was not replaced.
notes.action: With the user's yes, copy the precondition and the allow_unverified_image variable from {template} and tofu/modules/cloud-image-base/variables.tf of the template into the repo's module.
notes.after_replace: Run `tofu plan` in each environment: a base image without a checksum now fails. Give it allow_unverified_image = true (adding a checksum to a base that exists may replace the download and the base template); an environment other than tofu/environments/homelab passes it on only after `allow_unverified_image = optional(bool, false)` is added to base_images in its variables.tf and `allow_unverified_image = each.value.allow_unverified_image` to its base_image module in main.tf (see the template's).

notes.text: The OpenTofu modules check their inputs (address, VLAN, VMID, extra disk bus, checksum algorithm) and take new optional entry attributes: protection (the Proxmox protection flag), on_boot, description, ipv4_gateway per guest, cpu_type for VMs, dns_servers/dns_domain for containers. Leaving them out plans what the old modules planned. A static address without a gateway in its subnet is a plan warning.
